name: Souin Ningyou ~Oshiego to no Inkou~
original_name: 操淫人形～教え子との淫行～
source:
Main character used to direct AV films, but was overwhelmed with this industry and quit. But as he runs out of money, he returns to the idea of filming such movie again with a weak-willed actress. He organizes brainwashing seminars and tracks down suitable candidate for actress at a certain school. After infiltrating the school he is severely questioned by female teacher there. Luckily, he happens to have teacher's naughty photo from past life, so he intimidates both girls into shooting as shameless actresses.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公过去是一名成人电影导演，却对这个行业心灰意冷，选择了退出。钱财耗尽后，他又打起拍摄色情影片的主意，准备找一名意志薄弱的女演员下手。他开办洗脑讲座，并到某所学校物色合适人选。潜入校园后，一名女教师对他严加盘问。幸运的是，他手里恰好握有这名教师过去拍下的艳照，于是便以此威胁她和找到的女孩，逼迫两人毫无廉耻地出演影片。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vndb-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
